rule: Phase 8 D-11 (status alone answers state), src/domain/approval.py:36
summary: The approval status check at the manager gate (D06) and the confirm gate (E05, src/approval/confirm_core.py:858) can be removed without any unit test failing; only the DB consume WHERE clause is pinned, by a PG-only test.
expected: Each layer that checks status == APPROVED is pinned by a test with an approval whose status left APPROVED (EXPIRED/SKIPPED).
actual: Mutations D06 and E05 SURVIVED; the only pinned layer is src/persistence/execution_state.py:335 (tests/test_consume_approved_quantity_pg.py:180, skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL); the fake intent store does not check status.
impact: None today. A change to the consume query or a store without the check would let a CONFIRM on an expired/skipped approval reach place_entry with a green unit suite.
evidence: D06: remove `or approval.status != ApprovalResult.APPROVED` -> SURVIVED (test_execution_manager.py, test_phase19_gate.py, test_confirm_flow.py, test_live_tracer.py, test_demo_same_code_path.py). E05: `if stored is None or stored.status != ApprovalResult.APPROVED:` -> `if stored is None:` -> SURVIVED (test_confirm_core.py, test_confirm_flow.py, test_confirm_recheck.py).
reproduction: AUDIT/tmp/mutation_probe: python -B mut.py batchC.py (row D06) / batchE.py (row E05) against the scratch clone.
why_tests_miss: Every fixture approval is APPROVED in both result and status.
recommendation: Add a unit test per layer with dataclasses.replace(approval, status=ApprovalResult.EXPIRED); make tests/support/intent_store_fakes.py refuse a non-APPROVED status like the SQL.

rule: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 3 (SL on mark-price 1m klines, D037); simulator semantics 2.3.0
summary: The inclusive exact-touch boundary of the backtest stop (`low <= trigger` LONG, `high >= trigger` SHORT) is not pinned by any of 13 backtest test files, goldens included.
expected: A test where the mark minute touches the trigger exactly and the stop fires.
actual: Mutating to strict `<` / `>` SURVIVED (E22, E22b, E22c, E22d); the live counterpart (pre_placement.py:411, B17) is pinned.
impact: Code is correct today; a regression would make the backtest skip stops Binance fires, giving optimistic research results that drive the G1-G5 go-live decision.
evidence: E22b/E22c SURVIVED against test_backtest_exits.py, test_backtest_simulator.py, test_backtest_engine.py, test_backtest_goldens.py, test_backtest_lifecycle.py, test_backtest_terminal_engine.py, test_backtest_mark_hole_coverage.py, test_paper_parity.py; E22d SURVIVED against test_backtest_exits.py, test_backtest_chain.py, test_backtest_terminal_settlement.py, test_r_denominator_parity.py, test_backtest_determinism.py, test_backtest_records.py.
reproduction: AUDIT/tmp/mutation_probe: python -B mut.py batchF.py (rows E22b, E22c).
why_tests_miss: Fixture prices pass through the trigger rather than touching it exactly.
recommendation: Add parametrized exact-touch cases (LONG low == trigger, SHORT high == trigger) to tests/test_backtest_exits.py.

rule: one placement in flight per symbol (SYMBOL_HAS_OPEN_ORDER, src/execution/manager.py:526-541)
summary: Breaking the per-symbol in-flight slot makes its test hang instead of fail: the second call awaits a never-released _GatedGuard with no timeout, and pytest-timeout is not installed.
actual: D10 and D10b hit the harness timeout (900 s, 180 s).
impact: A hung CI run instead of a clear failure.
evidence: D10/D10b rows of the lane mutation table; test body at tests/test_execution_manager.py:4904-4911 awaits the second _run_plan without asyncio.wait_for.
recommendation: Wrap the second call in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=5).
